scope: Existing frozen-baseline mechanisms; no new architecture change or new learning claim.

checks.hypotheses: Attention weights sum to one; arbitrary value vectors and anchor. Actual code requires positive clipping epsilon.
checks.guarantee: Centered XSA equals the original clipped own-direction projection, including the clipped region.

checks.hypotheses: All value vectors are the same v and ||v|| >= xeps.
checks.guarantee: The real-arithmetic rotary causal XSA head output is zero, for arbitrary queries and keys.

checks.hypotheses: Mean-square energy m > 0 and epsilon > 0; c is the mean input/upstream product in the VJP interpretation.
checks.guarantee: The direct and separated tangent/radial coordinate formulas are algebraically equal.

checks.hypotheses: m > 0, epsilon > 0, upstream is a*x so its mean product with x is a*m.

checks.guarantee: The radial/tangent coefficient ratio remains epsilon/(m+epsilon). Rearrangement does not remove poor conditioning.
The scalar radial RMS derivative at zero is 1/sqrt(epsilon).

limitations: These are identities and local derivative properties over real arithmetic. They do not prove finite-precision error bounds, preservation of every PyTorch gradient at clipping boundaries, global network conditioning, or successful/faster grokking. Existing finite-precision regression tests are separate evidence.
